meta.title: Fill the product sheet by uploading a filled Excel template
gaps: Download the Excel template from the upload modal and edit its line-item details in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
Download the filled workbook as an .xlsx file and upload that workbook in the modal.
Click the modal's OK control to save the uploaded workbook.
Verify that the Product Sheet rows match the rows in the uploaded .xlsx file.
